findings.note: The central candidate-(a) integration is not functionally verified. The skill contains procedural prose, while the functional test starts from an already-assembled fragment and invokes check-risk-upgrade directly; it never exercises Registry enumeration, Project-Context component enumeration, evaluate-predicate invocation, union matching, fragment construction, or evaluator failure handling. Consequently the evidence cannot establish that the implemented intake gate actually produces the required Capability-derived signal.

The claimed mandatory second Capability-aware enforcement stage is not implemented or demonstrated. The staged skill says the ship-time invocation is unmodified, and the defense-in-depth test only confirms that ship/SKILL.md still invokes check-risk-upgrade; it does not show that ship computes or supplies a Capability fragment. A later diff-only Capability match can therefore remain invisible to the unchanged keyword-only recheck, contrary to the resolved OQ-002 two-stage contract.

The committed human-copy staging tree is not directly applicable by the required four-target runner because README.md and .github/workflows/test.yml are recursively classified as undeclared payload. The documented procedure requires deleting those tracked files before invoking the runner, so the delivered staging state does not itself satisfy AC-031's exact-set application contract and T-003's human-apply path remains operationally incomplete.
